business_profile.competitive_position: Kazi Law Chamber is one of Dhaka's most established firms — 30 years, global awards, Supreme Court presence, and a genuinely international client base. Their reputation is elite. The gap is intake: a wa.me link and a form. International clients comparing firms expect instant, professional, structured intake. An AI agent that triages every enquiry, collects matter details and documents before the first meeting, and responds across timezones would make their intake match their stature — and win cross-border matters that go to faster-responding firms.
business_profile.opportunity_size: With hundreds of corporate clients and an international roster, each matter is high-value. If slow/manual intake loses even a few cross-border or corporate matters per quarter to faster-responding firms, that's lakhs in lost fees. An AI intake agent that triages, collects documents, and books consultations — 24/7 across timezones — recovers this AND frees senior lawyers from unqualified enquiries.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI intake agent on WhatsApp + website that triages every enquiry by matter type (corporate, civil, criminal, immigration, commercial), collects key facts, and routes to the right lawyer.
2. Document-request agent that sends the correct checklist for each matter type before the first meeting, eliminating manual back-and-forth.
3. Timezone agent that answers international clients (UK/USA/Canada/EU/ASEAN) instantly, any hour.
4. Consultation scheduler that books appointments across the three offices with conflict-check intake and automated reminders.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A Bangladeshi entrepreneur in London needs a corporate matter handled in Dhaka and messages the WhatsApp line at 11pm UK time. In seconds the AI replies: 'Thank you for contacting Kazi Law Chamber. To route you to the right advocate, is this corporate/commercial, civil, or immigration? Please share a 2-line summary.' The client answers; the agent sends the relevant document checklist and books a consultation for 10am Dhaka time with a structured brief already on the lawyer's desk. The client never waited, and the lawyer starts prepared.
